# Looking ahead to our Paris Institutional Markets Event

- [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/sharing/share-offsite/?url=https%3A//www.santandercib.com/news-insights/events/looking-ahead-our-paris-institutional-markets-event)

As political decisions, geopolitical developments and shifting policy priorities continue to influence financial markets, institutional investors are considering a broader set of factors when assessing risk, opportunity and long-term investment strategy.


These themes will be at the centre of Santander CIB’s Paris Institutional Markets Event 2026, taking place on 6 October. The event will bring together institutional investors, market specialists and Santander CIB leaders to examine how the evolving geopolitical and policy environment is shaping the global investment landscape.


José M. Linares, SEVP, Santander, and Global Head of Santander CIB, will moderate the final panel, bringing together the key themes discussed throughout the event. Mike Bagguley, Global Head of Markets at Santander CIB, will host the event, open the programme and moderate a discussion focused on the investor perspective, while Laurence Boone, Head of the Paris Branch at Santander CIB, will lead a conversation on the geopolitical landscape.


**Santander CIB Paris Institutional Markets Event 2026**


**When:** 6 October 2026


**Where:** Paris, France


**Interested in joining us? Contact us by email to find out more about attending the event.**
